title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons Rider Premium Rate Schedule
content:
Each rider of the Optional Coverage Add-Ons carries a published monthly rider premium, added to the billing of the base contract the rider is attached to, and a published annual pay discount rate, the discount on the rider premium that applies when the base contract is billed annually.

## Rate table

| Rider | Monthly rider premium (USD) | Annual pay discount rate |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Second Refrigerator Rider | 4.99 | 10% (0.10) |
| Bridgewell Septic System Rider | 5.99 | 10% (0.10) |
| Bridgewell Well Pump Rider | 8.99 | 10% (0.10) |
| Bridgewell Limited Roof Leak Rider | 9.99 | 10% (0.10) |
| Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider | 14.99 | 10% (0.10) |
| Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider | 19.99 | 10% (0.10) |
| Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider | 24.99 | 10% (0.10) |

## Reading the table

- The monthly rider premium is a US dollar amount per month. It is the figure a rider's billing starts from, whether the base contract is billed monthly or annually.
- The annual pay discount rate is a decimal fraction of the rider premium. It is the same for all seven riders: 10 percent, written 0.10.
- The figures belong to the rider, not to the base contract: two riders of different kinds on one base contract each carry their own monthly rider premium from this table.

## Points of reference

**Which rider has the lowest monthly rider premium?** The Bridgewell Second Refrigerator Rider, at USD 4.99 a month; the Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider has the highest, at USD 24.99 a month.

**Does the annual pay discount rate vary by rider?** No. Every rider in the table shows 0.10.

**What is the gap between the two pool riders?** The Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider is USD 19.99 a month and the Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider USD 14.99 a month, a difference of USD 5.00 a month.
